verdict.rationale: Yubico ships an official CLI, ykman (YubiKey Manager), documented as a way to configure the YubiKey from the command line. A runtime probe confirms it installs from public registries, identifies itself, and offers scriptable management of applications, PINs, PIV/OATH/OTP slots and device info. Firmware docs also point to ykman for reading device state. missing for 10: in-depth first-party command reference excerpts for each operation (enabling applications, setting PINs, managing slots) and independent community corroboration of scripted ykman use.

support.subject: As a developer, I can configure and manage the key from an official CLI — enable applications, set PINs, manage slots, read device state — scriptably

citations.quote: Configure your YubiKey via the command line.
Full scriptable device management: enable applications, PINs, PIV/OATH/OTP slots, device info.
The quickest and most convenient way to determine your device's firmware version is to use either the Yubico Authenticator ... or ykman
